class.name: IfcStairType
class.brief_description: Definition from IAI : The element type IfcStairType defines a list of commonly shared property set definitions of a stair and an optional set of product representations. It is used to define a stair specification (i.e. the specific product information, that is common to all occurrences of that product type). members.member: Identifies the predefined types of a stair element from which the type required may be set. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as empty and can't be set.
